arStrings.szText: Upon the pyre, each Amazon ends. Faults forgiven...deeds remembered. Let her ash and bone join that of her sisters...
Somber, but proud. A soldier honoring the fallen. A lone Amazon watches as her sister Amazons, slain in battle, are burnedon a pyre. This is a funerary rite.
